test_instructions: Open Settings -> FancyZones and keep the default Shift-to-activate behavior enabled.

Reproduce the reported transition, such as RDP into the machine and return to the physical console, then drag a window without holding Shift and verify the FancyZones overlay does not appear on the first drag.
Hold Shift while dragging and verify zones still activate and snapping still works.
If the stale latch reproduces on an unpatched build, tap Shift once before the first drag and verify it clears the phantom activation; the patched build should not require this tap.
